_comment: North is on 0 Life with no cards in hand and no Blocker; its Leader has 5000 power (attached DON!! only adds power during its owner's turn). South's Leader already attacked (rested); South's only attacker is Sai (4000). Attacking right away bounces off; South must first give at least 1 DON!! to Sai (+1000). Expected: a 'don:' action on Sai first; attacking first is a blunder.
